instruction: You are standing at the entrance of a room, turn around then slightly turn right and go one step forward, slightly turn left and go forward, go forward until you reach an opened brown door, from the entrance go one step forward, turn left and go forward towards the opened brown door, slightly turn left and go one step forward, slightly turn left and go forward until you reach the cupboards, here just beside an opened brown door facing towards empty shelf you have reached the destination.
